findings.highlight: I didn't bring any other clothes meant for when I go out apart from what I'm wearing
findings.evidenceJa: これ以外は外出用しか持ってきてなくてさぁ
findings.explanation: Chiaki says that apart from what she is currently wearing, she brought only outdoor clothes, which is why she wants something to wear indoors. The translation says she brought no other outdoor clothes except the current outfit, reversing the inventory and the request's practical premise.
findings.japanese:
「そだ春希、服貸してよ。
これ以外は外出用しか持ってきてなくてさぁ」
findings.todokanai: "Oh yeah, Haruki, lend me some clothes. I didn't bring any other clothes meant for when I go out apart from what I'm wearing, you see."

findings.highlight: time will change everything
findings.evidenceJa: 時間が何かを変えることもある
findings.explanation: Chiaki cautiously says time can sometimes change something. The translation turns possibility into certainty and an unspecified something into everything, overstating the healing claim Haruki immediately disputes.
findings.japanese:
「変わるよ。
春希が何もしなくても、
時間が何かを変えることもある」
findings.todokanai: "Things will change. Even if you don't do anything, Haruki, time will change everything."

findings.highlight: But I'm alright. You don't have to be so worried about me. I'll be able to cheer up somehow by staying like this.
findings.evidenceJa:
でも大丈夫だって。
そんなに心配しないでくれよ。
俺は、なんとかこうして元気にやってるからさ。
findings.explanation: A statement that someone is presently managing okay can become a future assurance that they will cheer up.
findings.japanese:
でも大丈夫だって。
そんなに心配しないでくれよ。
俺は、なんとかこうして元気にやってるからさ。
findings.todokanai: But I'm alright. You don't have to be so worried about me. I'll be able to cheer up somehow by staying like this.

findings.highlight: My mother
findings.evidenceJa: ウチの親
findings.explanation: Chiaki says her parent teaches at a private school. The source does not specify which parent; the translation invents her mother as the teacher, creating an unsupported family fact.
findings.japanese:
「ウチの親、私立校の教師やってたから結構もらうんだ。
それで時々申し込むの忘れて期限切らしちゃうし。
ま、有効利用よ、有効利用」
findings.todokanai: "My mother gets a lot of these since she teaches at a private school. Some of these expire every now and then since we forget to use them. So I'm just being efficient, see?"

findings.highlight: one half out of three
findings.evidenceJa: ０勝２敗１分
findings.explanation: Haruki's exact record is zero wins, two losses, one draw. 'One half out of three' discards the win-loss-draw categories and corrupts the arithmetic system he is using to manage uncertainty.
findings.japanese:
結論から言うと、１勝２敗。
厳密に言えば、０勝２敗１分。
findings.todokanai: That's one out of three. Or, to be more precise, one half out of three.

findings.highlight: One and a half out of three
findings.evidenceJa: １勝１敗１分
findings.explanation: This record is one win, one loss, and one draw. The translation converts it into one and a half out of three, again erasing the categorical evidence in Haruki's inventory calculation.
findings.japanese: こちらは、１勝１敗１分。
findings.todokanai: One and a half out of three this time.

findings.highlight: come back to bite you
findings.evidenceJa: 刺されないようにしとけよ
findings.explanation: Uehara warns Chiaki not to get stabbed by the lover she is deceiving. The English replaces the literal interpersonal threat with consequences coming back to bite her, sanitizing the danger that closes his ethical warning.
findings.japanese:
「『芸の肥やし』が悪いとは言わないし、
そういうところに賭けてる気持ちもあるけどさ。
…刺されないようにしとけよ？」
findings.todokanai: "There's nothing wrong with you wanting to 'improve your art,' and I can tell you're willing to stake everything on it. Just don't… do anything that'll come back to bite you, alright?"

findings.highlight: pretending like she's spoiling me and wanting me to desire it
findings.evidenceJa: 甘えてるふりをして、俺を甘えさせようって
findings.explanation: Chiaki pretends to depend on or act spoiled toward Haruki while actually trying to let him depend on her. The translation makes the first half her spoiling him and the second his desire, losing the deliberately reversed care method highlighted by the approved note.
findings.japanese:
俺の全身に覆い被さるように、
甘えてるふりをして、俺を甘えさせようって。
findings.todokanai: As if to envelop my entire body, pretending like she's spoiling me and wanting me to desire it.

findings.highlight: comes across as a bit hurtful
findings.evidenceJa: 千晶が気を使って茶化してくれてるのが、今の精神状態だと、痛いほど伝わってくる
findings.explanation: In his current state, Haruki perceives with painful clarity that Chiaki is teasing him out of consideration. The translation says her teasing itself feels hurtful, reversing recognition of care into interpersonal injury.
findings.japanese:
千晶が気を使って茶化してくれてるのが、
今の精神状態だと、痛いほど伝わってくる。
findings.todokanai: The way Chiaki's poking fun at me actually comes across as a bit hurtful, considering my current mental state.

findings.highlight: "Whoa, do I really have such an effect on you? Could it be that I am the most important woman in your life right now?"
findings.evidenceJa:
「わ、あたし春希にそんな影響与えてるんだ。
もしかして、一番気になる女性？」
findings.explanation: The woman Haruki is most concerned with can become the most important woman in his life.
findings.japanese:
「わ、あたし春希にそんな影響与えてるんだ。
もしかして、一番気になる女性？」
findings.todokanai: "Whoa, do I really have such an effect on you? Could it be that I am the most important woman in your life right now?"

findings.highlight: arms wrapped around her head
findings.evidenceJa: 首に回した腕にぎゅっと力を込めて
findings.explanation: Chiaki tightens the arms she has wrapped around Haruki's neck, answering his question physically. The English relocates the arms around her own head, making the intimate response anatomically incoherent.
findings.japanese:
ただ、首に回した腕にぎゅっと力を込めて、
俺の言葉に、態度で答える。
findings.todokanai: She merely squeezes the arms wrapped around her head, responding to my words with her attitude.

findings.highlight: The stream of passion flows
findings.evidenceJa: 今日、何度目になるかわからない迸りが走った
findings.explanation: An ejaculation of a count Haruki can no longer determine that day runs through their joined bodies. 'Stream of passion' erases both the concrete sexual event and the unknown repetition count that measures their enclosed routine.
findings.japanese:
ずっと動かずに繋がったままだった結合部から、
今日、何度目になるかわからない迸りが走った。
findings.todokanai: The stream of passion flows through our joined parts, which have stayed connected all this time.

findings.highlight: she's hugging me tighter than before
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が強く抱き寄せたからなのか
findings.explanation: Haruki cannot tell whether Chiaki leaned closer or he pulled her more tightly against himself. The translation makes Chiaki the agent in both alternatives, erasing his own embrace and the deliberately unresolved reciprocity.
findings.japanese:
今までよりも千晶が身体を寄せたからなのか、
今までよりも俺が強く抱き寄せたからなのか…
findings.todokanai: Is it because Chiaki is leaning closer to me, or is it because she's hugging me tighter than before…?

findings.highlight: she replaces Setsuna's singing voice with her own
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜の歌声に、自分の歌声を委ねて
findings.explanation: Chiaki entrusts her voice to Setsuna's recorded singing, an act whose exact singing form the approved note leaves open. The translation says she replaces Setsuna's voice, reversing participation or submission into displacement.
findings.japanese: 雪菜の歌声に、自分の歌声を委ねて。
findings.todokanai: And she replaces Setsuna's singing voice with her own.

findings.highlight: making people rely on them
findings.evidenceJa: 人に頼られる方は…お前と同じで得意だった
findings.explanation: Kazusa was good at being relied upon, like Chiaki. The translation says they were good at making other people rely on them, reversing the direction of dependence and changing the character comparison.
findings.japanese: 「人に頼られる方は…お前と同じで得意だったけどな」
findings.todokanai: "But in terms of making people rely on them… you two are the same in that regard."

findings.highlight: Things haven't developed so peacefully over the past three years
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の三年は、そんなに安くない
findings.explanation: Haruki says his three years are not so cheap: recovery cannot instantly erase their value and pain. The translation replaces that valuation with events not developing peacefully, losing the reason he rejects 'full recovery.'
findings.japanese:
まだ、雪菜のことを吹っ切れた訳じゃない。
俺の三年は、そんなに安くない。
findings.todokanai: I'm still not completely over Setsuna. Things haven't developed so peacefully over the past three years.

findings.highlight: Such memories dating almost ten or so years must still dwell inside me now…
findings.evidenceJa: あの十数年は、今の俺の中にも息づいてるはずだ…
findings.explanation: The dozen-plus years alive within Haruki become memories from almost ten years ago.
findings.japanese: あの十数年は、今の俺の中にも息づいてるはずだ…
findings.todokanai: Such memories dating almost ten or so years must still dwell inside me now…

findings.highlight: with how good she actually is at cleaning up
findings.evidenceJa: 千晶の片づけスキルだと
findings.explanation: The joke assumes Chiaki's poor tidying skill makes restoring scattered belongings to their former volume an advanced technique. The English explicitly calls her good at cleaning up before saying she lacks the ability, reversing the characterization and making the sentence self-contradictory.
findings.japanese:
それに、千晶の片づけスキルだと、
一度散らかしたものを元の容積に戻すなんて高級技術は…
findings.todokanai: Besides, with how good she actually is at cleaning up, she doesn't have it in her to return things that she made a mess of back to their original state…

findings.highlight: since I can make a comment about her messy luggage
findings.evidenceJa: 額面通りで野暮な荷物関連のコメントは、きちんと封印できるくらいには自分を取り戻していた
findings.explanation: Haruki has recovered enough to seal away the tactless, literal luggage comment and instead ask whether Chiaki plans to leave. The translation says making the luggage comment proves his recovery, reversing the act of self-control.
findings.japanese:
…なんて、額面通りで野暮な荷物関連のコメントは、
きちんと封印できるくらいには自分を取り戻していた。
findings.todokanai: …Well, since I can make a comment about her messy luggage, that just means I'm back to my normal self.

findings.highlight: I spoke as if I received quite a shock
findings.evidenceJa: 実は結構ショックを受ける発言だったりした
findings.explanation: Chiaki's statement actually shocks Haruki considerably despite his wry smile. The English says he spoke as though he had received a shock, changing an internal reaction into a performed utterance and weakening its sincerity.
findings.japanese:
苦笑を浮かべつつも、
実は結構ショックを受ける発言だったりした。
findings.todokanai: Despite a bitter smile forming on my face, in actuality, I spoke as if I received quite a shock.

findings.highlight: suffered mercilessly from your perverted acts
findings.evidenceJa: 春希にえっちなこと、散々叩き込まれた
findings.explanation: Chiaki says Haruki thoroughly drilled or taught sexual things into her, consistent with the route's learning and performance motif. The translation invents merciless suffering from perverted acts, converting learned experience into victimization.
findings.japanese:
「春希にえっちなこと、散々叩き込まれた、
この和泉千晶がさぁ…っ」
findings.todokanai: "This Izumi Chiaki, who has suffered mercilessly from your perverted acts, Haruki…"

findings.highlight: I would gladly stay together with her forever
findings.evidenceJa: あいつさえ望めば、いつまでいてくれても良かった
findings.explanation: If Chiaki wanted, Haruki would have been content for her to stay in his room as long as she liked. The translation makes Haruki the one staying together, adds 'forever,' and erases that the duration and residence were hers to choose.
findings.japanese: あいつさえ望めば、いつまでいてくれても良かった。
findings.todokanai: I would gladly stay together with her forever if she were to ever desire that.
